evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: Assist with cleanup and standardization efforts of DBT instance
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: Rigour by default rather than emphasis: the only quality-adjacent signal is 'cleanup and standardization efforts of DBT instance', and the JD carries no speed or shipping-pace language at all.
evidence.domain_risk: Partner with Supply Chain, Retail Execution, Commercial Finance and other stakeholders to understand workflows and improve them with data tools
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: Moderate: the work feeds operational and commercial decisions at a food manufacturer, with Commercial Finance named only as a partner and no audit, compliance or financial-reporting language.
evidence.collaboration_width: Supply Chain; Retail Execution; Commercial Finance; data engineers
evidence.data_team_maturity: Assist with cleanup and standardization efforts of DBT instance
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: Mid: Snowflake and a dbt instance are already in production and data engineers exist as a separate group — the work is tidying and extending what is there.
evidence.jd_authorship: Create custom pipelines to ingest data into Snowflake data warehouse from external sources as needed
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: Mixed: three bullets name the real stack and the real backlog (Snowflake ingestion, dbt cleanup, reporting gaps from system upgrades) while the rest are generic ('Help automate manual processes and improve how data is delivered').
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: Partner with Supply Chain, Retail Execution, Commercial Finance and other stakeholders to understand workflows and improve them with data tools
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: Mixed: three distinct business functions are named in one breath — Supply Chain, Retail Execution and Commercial Finance — with none given priority over the others.
evidence.autonomy_level: Assist with addressing any gaps in reporting as result of system upgrades and system implementations
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: Execution: the responsibility verbs are 'Help' and 'Assist with' for half the list, and the role is framed as supporting business teams' stated needs rather than setting direction.
evidence.ai_role_explanation: None: neither AI tooling nor AI-consuming data products appear anywhere in the JD.
evidence.testing_framing: No testing, data contract, observability or data quality language appears in the JD.
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: Absent: dbt is named but only as an instance to clean up and standardise — no testing tool, quality framework or ownership of data reliability is mentioned.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: None: the JD is framed entirely in terms of delivering reports, models and automation, with no mention of risk, compliance or the cost of getting numbers wrong.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: Assist with cleanup and standardization efforts of DBT instance
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: Fix/scale: the infrastructure work is remediation — dbt cleanup, closing reporting gaps left by system upgrades, automating existing manual processes.
